# Leads Rubix

> Leads Rubix is a CRM purpose-built for India's high-velocity sales teams across real estate, education, healthcare, BFSI, automotive, travel, SaaS, and manufacturing. We capture leads from Facebook & Instagram lead ads in real time, automatically rotate them via round-robin, and provide GPS-verified call tracking, Razorpay-native bookings, and auto-generated GST invoices.

The product is offered as a SaaS subscription. Pricing starts at ₹999 per user per month (Starter), ₹1,499 per user per month (Growth), with a custom Enterprise tier. A 7-day free trial is available with no credit card. The company is headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://leadsrubix.com/): Product overview and primary value proposition.
- [Pricing](https://leadsrubix.com/pricing): All three plans, an interactive ROI calculator, comparison matrix, and pricing FAQ. Listed in INR; switchable to USD/AED for reference.
- [Features](https://leadsrubix.com/features): Lead capture, routing, calling, bookings, payments, analytics.
- [Industries](https://leadsrubix.com/solutions): Index of the eight verticals supported.
- [Compare](https://leadsrubix.com/compare): Honest comparison hub for vendor selection.
- [FAQ](https://leadsrubix.com/faq): Categorised answers to common product questions.
